```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The labor movement fought for unemployment, disability and old-age insurance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The feminist movement fought for parental leave and publicly funded child care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Movements of the poor fought for income security, job training and affordable higher education.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many Americans devalue social rights because they believe their security results from personal responsibility and individual initiative.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Only in the United States is child support and health care for adults and children means-tested.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Until the Obama health care reforms, only the poor received federally funded health care for their children and themselves.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Only poor women unable to find jobs in the labor market that provided health insurance and sufficient wages to pay for child care received federal funds to stay at home to care for infants.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Citizens who earned just above the poverty line have resented the poorer members of their community who received state-funded health care and child support.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Resentment fueled the vicious politics of welfare reform and the hostility of elements of the American working class toward the poor.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
